limitations: Only a one-document/one-chunk public fixture was used for this backup E2E. The separate legacy stage used the real 9451-document corpus and real RAG/models.
No CANN index, knowledge program, legacy/private Runtime or private profile is archived by this document binding.
The team enabled-plan generator and Docker Compose parser were run against the real IM+CANN backup; Agents were not started and no mixed Runtime+CANN restoration is claimed.

Backup requires an exclusive maintenance window on the Docker daemon. Concurrent container deletion may fail the global ownership inspection. Serial passing tests do not implement daemon-wide exclusion or repair that race.
Only restore trusted, immutable backups. Hashes detect damage, not origin; do not edit an archive between verification and extraction.
No GHCR digest, clean Linux installation or final release artifact/browser acceptance in this stage. v0.1.0 remains incomplete.
